Tap the floating button with the pencil icon (Customize) when viewing the cover of a closed notebook. You can change the spine color, paper texture, and background color.
In the gallery, below the selected notebook, you will find icons to create an exact copy of the entire notebook or send it to the trash.
"Select the menu icon of your notebook (top left) and choose 'Export'. You can generate a .scrap file (backup), or share it as a .pdf or .png."
"Tap the '+' button in the bottom menu. Select 'Import image' or 'Import PDF'. Multi-page documents will be automatically added as consecutive spreads."
For complex works, open the layers panel. Draw backgrounds and strokes on different levels to edit them separately without ruining the rest of your design.
Long press a notebook in the gallery to enter reorganization mode. Then drag it left or right to change its position on the shelf.
Inside an open notebook, swipe horizontally to change pages. If you are on the last one, swiping will automatically create a blank page.

Tap the paper icon in the bottom bar to change the ruling of the sheet: ruled, grid, dots, graph paper and more. A spread is two real pages, so you can change the left one, the right one, both, or the whole notebook at once.
Use the lasso/scissor tool to enclose an area of your drawing. You can move, rotate, or delete that fragment without affecting the rest of the page.
"Write text with the 'T' tool or tap the stickers icon in the bottom panel to add shapes, geometric frames, or illustrations to your canvas."
In the top bar you will find markers, pencils and highlighters. Tap a selected tool to adjust its thickness. Each tool will remember its color and size!
When you open a notebook and simply want to read or view your creations, the interface and menus will disappear to not distract you. Tap the screen to show the controls again.
Use the two-finger pinch gesture on the canvas to zoom in on the details of your drawing, and drag with two fingers to pan around the page.

"**PRIVACY POLICY**
Last updated: July 2026
Your privacy is fundamental to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose and safeguard your information when you use the Scraply mobile application.
**1. Collection and Use of Information** Scraply is designed to be a private creative tool. **We neither ask you for nor collect information that identifies you personally** (such as your name, email address or phone number). All the content you create - including your notebooks, drawings, text and imported images - is stored **strictly locally on your device**. We neither transmit nor store your designs on our servers. There are, however, limited exceptions in which technical data does leave the device: the diagnostic and advertising services described in section 3. Those services never receive your content - they do not see your notebooks, your drawings or your photos.
**2. Device Permissions** To provide you with all of Scraply's features, we may request the following permissions: • **Access to Photos/Media/Files (Gallery):** Required solely to let you import images from your local photo gallery for use as elements inside your notebooks. We do not access, extract or analyse your gallery for any other purpose.
**3. Third-Party Services, Diagnostics and Advertising** Three Google services run inside Scraply. None of them receives your creations.
• **Firebase Crashlytics (stability).** If the app closes unexpectedly, it sends a report containing technical information about the device (model, operating system version) and the technical state of the App at the moment of failure (stack traces).
• **Firebase Analytics (usage).** Aggregate, non-identifying statistics about which features are used and how the App performs, so we know what to improve.
• **Google AdMob (advertising).** Scraply is free and is funded by advertising. Specifically, exporting a notebook as **PDF or as images** shows a rewarded video ad every few exports; the counter is visible in the export menu, so you always know when one is coming. Exporting in Scraply's own **.scrap** format never shows advertising, and neither does any other part of the App. To select and measure ads, Google may process your device's **advertising identifier** together with technical data such as the approximate location derived from your IP address, the device type and your interaction with the ad. You can reset or delete that identifier at any time from Android Settings > Privacy > Ads. More information: Google Privacy Policy (policies.google.com/privacy) and How Google uses information from sites or apps that use our services (policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites).
**Consent (European Economic Area, United Kingdom and Switzerland).** If you are in one of those regions, on first launch we show you a consent form managed by Google's User Messaging Platform, where you choose whether we may use your data for personalised advertising. If you decline, you will still see ads, but they will not be personalised.
**4. Notifications** Scraply may send you occasional notifications to remind you about your notebooks and to share news. They are sent through Firebase Cloud Messaging, which assigns your installation a technical device identifier (not a personal one) that disappears when you uninstall the app. You can turn them off at any time from Android's notification settings.
**5. Data Security** Because your creations are stored locally, the security of this data depends on the physical and digital security measures of your own device. We recommend keeping your device protected with passwords, a PIN or biometrics.
**6. Children's Privacy** Scraply is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children, and we do not ask any user for identifying information. Because the App shows advertising, if you are a parent or guardian and believe a child has used Scraply, you can reset or delete the device's advertising identifier from Android Settings > Privacy > Ads.
**7. Changes to this Privacy Policy** We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy in this same section of the App. We advise you to review this policy periodically to stay aware of any changes.
**8. Contact Us** If you have questions, comments or concerns about our Privacy Policy, please do not hesitate to get in touch through Scraply's official support channels."

Six spreads to mount your photos: overlapping frames, polaroids with room to write on and a page to tell the story.
The notebook as an object: navy cover from edge to edge, matching elastic band and twelve blank sheets. It arrives wrapped in its paper band — unwrap it and it is yours.
An enamelled heart at the centre of the cover, over cream leather grain, with blush paper inside.
A cat medallion threaded on the elastic band. Ink-black covers and blank sheets with a trail of paw prints along the outer corner.
Sixteen pages of letters, quotes and reasons, on love-letter paper — with an envelope to fill in and seal.
Three golden butterflies threaded on the elastic band, and the flight of three more crossing the corner of every sheet.
The whole year: twelve months, each with its calendar across the full spread, its 31-day habit tracker and its balance.
Twelve pages for the one with four paws: profile, the day they arrived, vet record, milestones and photo grids.
Six spreads, six lessons: draw, add photos, decorate and change the paper. You learn by using it, and the last sheet is left blank so you can start.
A whole month, four numbered weeks. Every day with its date field and its lines, the weekend washed out, and a close of habits and notes.
